findings: Arthur Haines actual plant and Donna Kausen emerging fertile shoots: delicate branched whorls with secondary drooping branchlets. Third Haines drawing is illustration, supplementary only. Model chooses green spring vegetative shoots, not fertile brown shoots. Three geometry passes were compared. Final seeds1,4,7 and all36 panels show three separated spring shoots with sparse whorls and attached secondary branchlets. The 23–50 cm plants retain actual scale. Fine branchlets still merge into coarse tiers in the smallest compact variants; full botanical delicacy is not achievable with25mm opaque cells. The final sparse developing vegetative form improves on the former solid dense branching. Accepted as a stylized spring source with this explicit limitation; user endorsement remains separate. Ground connections require soil embedding.
